title: Global oxygen minimum zones: model assessment and the ssp245 change

method.units: model o2 converted from mol m-3 to umol/kg with an in-situ density field from each model's own thetao and so; a constant moves the third significant figure

density_note.GFDL-ESM4|historical: density field, read as an anomaly (sigma, + 1000) from its long_name, 'In-situ density anomaly'; 996.6 to 1057.3 kg/m3 cell by cell (each cell's own in-situ pressure); converted at each cell's own density
density_note.MPI-ESM1-2-LR|historical: density field, read as an anomaly (sigma, + 1000) from its long_name, 'In-situ density anomaly'; 1003.9 to 1053.8 kg/m3 cell by cell (each cell's own in-situ pressure); converted at each cell's own density
density_note.CESM2|ssp245: density field, read as an anomaly (sigma, + 1000) from its long_name, 'In-situ density anomaly'; 1004.9 to 1052.4 kg/m3 cell by cell (each cell's own in-situ pressure); converted at each cell's own density
density_note.GFDL-ESM4|ssp245: density field, read as an anomaly (sigma, + 1000) from its long_name, 'In-situ density anomaly'; 996.0 to 1057.3 kg/m3 cell by cell (each cell's own in-situ pressure); converted at each cell's own density
density_note.MPI-ESM1-2-LR|ssp245: density field, read as an anomaly (sigma, + 1000) from its long_name, 'In-situ density anomaly'; 1002.9 to 1053.8 kg/m3 cell by cell (each cell's own in-situ pressure); converted at each cell's own density

method.observations: WOA23 1971-2000 climate normal, NOT the all-period composite; the two differ by about 5 per cent in OMZ volume
method.grid: every volume, inventory and thickness on the source's own grid and own vertical levels; regridding is horizontal and for the figures only
method.thickness: the OMZ thickness sums the thickness of each sub-threshold cell, taken for the models as volcello / areacello so that partial cells at the sea floor count only the water they hold; WOA23 has no partial cells and uses its layer bounds
method.inventory: integrated from the model's native mol m-3 field, so no density enters the volume integral at all; the umol/kg field is not used here because converting it back would apply a constant density
method.marginal_seas: folded into their parent ocean (select_basin default)
method.southern_and_arctic_oceans: separate basins in the WOA23 mask, not included in the Atlantic, Indian or Pacific numbers
method.cesm2: publishes no historical o2, so it appears only in the ssp245 results

basin_definitions.Pacific: WOA23 basinmask_01: Pacific Ocean, WOA23 codes [2, 12, 14, 18, 19, 25, 27, 28, 29, 33, 38, 39, 40, 41, 42, 44, 51, 54, 57, 59], with its marginal seas and sub-basins folded in (Sea of Japan, Sulu Sea, Sea of Okhotsk, Banda Sea, South China Sea, Celebes Sea, Aleutian Basin, Fiji Basin, Coral Sea, Southeast Pacific Basin, Guatemala Basin, East Caroline Basin, Marianas Basin, Philippine Sea, Chile Basin, Tasman Sea, Sulu Sea II, Java Sea, Chiloe); the Southern Ocean (WOA23 code 10) and the Arctic Ocean (code 11) are separate basins and are NOT included; the surface basin labels, applied through the whole water column

basin_definitions.Atlantic: WOA23 basinmask_01: Atlantic Ocean, WOA23 codes [1, 4, 5, 6, 9, 15, 16, 17, 20, 22, 23, 30, 31, 36, 37, 48, 49, 50, 55], with its marginal seas and sub-basins folded in (Mediterranean Sea, Baltic Sea, Black Sea, Hudson Bay, Baffin Bay, East Mediterranean, West Mediterranean, Caribbean Sea, North Caribbean, Gulf of Mexico, North American Basin, West European Basin, Southwest Atlantic Basin, Southeast Atlantic Basin, Guinea Basin, Brazil Basin, Argentine Basin, Venezuela Basin); the Southern Ocean (WOA23 code 10) and the Arctic Ocean (code 11) are separate basins and are NOT included; the surface basin labels, applied through the whole water column

findings: Both historical models overestimate the OMZ. At the 60 threshold the observed volume is 80.3e15 m3 against GFDL-ESM4 105e15, MPI-ESM1-2-LR 214e15; GFDL-ESM4 is the closer of the two. Overestimating the OMZ is a documented common bias.

Under ssp245 the two models do not agree on the sign of the change: GFDL-ESM4 +4.4% at 60 and -4.1% at 20; MPI-ESM1-2-LR -0.7% at 60 and -3.0% at 20. The threshold matters as much as the model: the suboxic core and the hypoxic envelope need not move together, which is why both thresholds are asked for. Each change compares two periods of one continuous run (r1i1p1f1 in both experiments), but it also contains whatever drift the model's pre-industrial control still carries, which cannot be removed without a piControl run.

Inside the observed OMZ the mean apparent oxygen utilization is 271.3 micromoles per kilogram and the mean saturation is 11.3 per cent. A high AOU with a low saturation says the zone is set by the respiration of sinking organic matter in water that has been out of contact with the atmosphere for a long time, rather than by cold, poorly ventilated water that was already low in oxygen when it left the surface.

CESM2 could not be assessed against observations or given a scenario change at all, because the historical experiment publishes no o2 for it. Its ssp245 OMZ is reported and drawn, but it cannot be told whether that state is a change or a pre-existing bias.
